Setting out and learning to sail
After the Trojan War, Odysseus sets sail for home, on a journey that lasts longer than he expects.

You too move from knowing tool names to building your first programs. Variables, functions, data and errors are your sailing tools; small Go and Python programs become the first ship you steer yourself.
Small independent programs and an organized repository
Identity, ingenuity and finding a way out
In the cave of Polyphemus, Odysseus calls himself Nobody and devises a careful plan for his companions to escape.

In a backend, a username alone does not establish a valid identity. You pass this stage through HTTP, databases, authentication and ownership checks; your API must know who has arrived and which data they may access.
A private API with persistent data and access control
Harnessing a force that can change your course
Aeolus seals the opposing winds in a bag. Odysseus's companions open it, and the winds drive the ship away from its destination.

Concurrency, environment settings and dependencies can also change a program's results when left unchecked. Testing, goroutines, Docker and reproducible experiments teach you to turn the wind into a force that carries you forward.
A tested, containerized service and your first MNIST model
Circe transforms Odysseus's companions; with Hermes's help, Odysseus overcomes the enchantment and restores them.

Here data becomes something visible and interactive. TypeScript and React help you understand changes in state and their effects on the interface; learning about CPUs and GPUs also reveals what happens beneath the surface. Every change should have a clear cause.
A React panel connected to an API, with loading, error and success states
Passing the temptation of misleading results
To hear the Sirens' song, Odysseus has himself tied to the mast; his companions, with wax in their ears, sail the ship past the danger.

A larger model or a prettier accuracy figure does not always mean progress. Fixed metrics, separate data and memory measurements are your mast; fine-tuning and evaluation help you separate claims from reproducible results.
A before-and-after training report with metrics and hardware limits
Recognizing home and showing who you have become
Odysseus finally reaches Ithaca; being recognized and reuniting with his home and family form the final part of his journey.

The things you have learned come together in StudioFlow. A product, tests, deployment, a README and the story behind your decisions show the abilities you have built on this journey. The path ends with a portfolio delivery and the start of your next professional chapter.
StudioFlow, a portfolio and a clear account of technical decisions
